srs: The vehicle rental system records Driver, Rental, RentalService, and Vehicle; each has an id attribute. Each Driver can have zero or more Rental records, and each Rental belongs to exactly one Driver. Each Rental uses exactly one RentalService, and each RentalService serves zero or more Rental records. Each RentalService manages one or more Vehicle records by composition, and each Vehicle belongs to exactly one RentalService. Each Driver can reference zero or more Vehicle records, and each Vehicle can be referenced by zero or more Driver records.
